title: Software Development Engineer
description: Job Title: Java Full stack Developer Location: Somajiguda, Hyderabad Work Mode: Onsite Shift Timings: 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM IST Key responsibilities: Be heavily involved with design and product teams to understand needs, propose features, create early prototypes and transform them into exciting experiences. Design new, secure, and reliable features that drive best customer experience. Know how to integrate information between multiple services. Write clean, maintainable code with unit tests, logs, metrics while adhering to industry best practices. Deep dive into client or server systems to optimize for performance, maintainability, extensibility, and more as needed. Identify feature enhancement opportunities. Work with multiple services end to end. Work alongside other engineers to deliver solutions. Provide continuous updates to leadership and stakeholders. Troubleshoot and resolve software bugs and production issues. Required Soft Skills: Should be able to communicate proactively and clearly with stakeholders. Work in dynamic and fast paced environment. Take full ownership of task end to end with resolving ambiguities and doing deep dives. Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to handle complex software challenges. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Fluent in programming languages such as java, typescript and react. 4\+ years of Full stack development including frontend and backend applications. Experience with AWS resources like lambda, ECS, etc. Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability, and scaling) of new and existing systems Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.
